### Observed differences

- Activity A01 was absent from the earlier window (0 of 200 traces) but was executed exactly once in every trace of the later window (200 of 200 traces, mean 1.0 occurrence per trace, never repeated within a trace). [OCC001]
- In the earlier window, A06 occurred in all 200 traces at the final trace position and no outgoing transitions from it were observed. In the later window, all of A06's observed outgoing transitions lead to A01 (200 of 200). [DIR001, POS002]
- The relationship between the two activities changed completely: earlier, A06 appeared without A01 in 200 of 200 traces (no co-occurrence); later, both appeared together in 200 of 200 traces, with A06 before A01 every time. [REL001]
- Positions match this: in the later window A01 always sits at the final position (median 1.0), while A06 moved from the final position (median 1.0 in all earlier traces) to slightly earlier (median about 0.88, typically between about 0.83 and 0.90), with slightly more positional variability than before. [POS001, POS002]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports the hypothesis that A01 was added as a new mandatory final step executed directly after A06. In the earlier window, cases ended with A06 and never contained A01; in the later window, every case runs A06 and then A01 last: A01's participation rose from 0 of 200 to 200 of 200 traces, A06 precedes A01 in 200 of 200 later traces, and the A06→A01 edge carries all of A06's observed outgoing transitions. A06's shift from the last position to about 0.85–0.90 of the trace is consistent with A01 being inserted after it. [OCC001, DIR001, REL001, POS001, POS002]

This exceeds what an unchanged process typically produces: five control-flow items qualified where about 0.04 were expected by chance, and each difference is larger than in about 199 of 200 random re-splits of the pooled data. The five items describe one underlying difference rather than independent confirmations, but they are mutually consistent and show the change directly through participation, relation, direction and position. [OCC001, DIR001, POS001, POS002, REL001]

Limitations: zero participation in the earlier window strictly means only that A01 was not observed there, so the evidence cannot rule out that A01 existed earlier as an extremely rare variant (too rare to appear in 200 traces) that later became universal — though even then its participation changed from unobserved to mandatory in every case. The evidence also covers only the behaviour around A06 and A01 at the end of the process. [OCC001, DIR001]
